newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bourse carry forward trades - July 26.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bourse carry forward trades - July 26.

text.p: The following is the trade data for the top stocks at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) for the carry-forward or "badla" account on Saturday at 11:30 a.m. SCRIP HAWALA Last Badla AVG AVG VOL VAL
RATE Badla Yield BADLA YIELD QTY (million)
The "badla" is interest rate for carry-forward trades. These are arrived through unique transactions which takes into account oversold and overbought positions and money supply.
The average badla charges worked out to 20.75 percent on an annualised basis against 25.75 percent in the previous carry forward account ended June 19.
